changelog: R17 alignment folded into the role-packs: composer spec-boundary step (adversarial precedents on load-bearing clauses; reject codebase-to-spec reverse authorship; 89% compliance ceiling), engineer verifier-engineering discipline + loop-charter gate for loop-type skills, guidance per-surface branches (tool/action/memory). Conductor gate logic untouched; five L0 gates green.
summary: Build a NEW agent skill from scratch, end-to-end — a thin conductor dispatches fresh subagents through five gated roles (compose spec -> design structure -> red-green build -> compress -> independent attack). EXPENSIVE (large token cost): trigger ONLY on an explicit user request to author/build/create an agent skill — "build me a skill", "create a new skill", "package this repeated workflow so it triggers automatically", "$skill-creator-max". Do-NOT fire for: summarizing or writing daily/session memory or journaling (incl. Chinese "总结/记录今天的记忆"), or any generic "create/make/summarize X" that is not authoring an agent skill.
